Member.description: A club player, arbiter or coach. A first name alone is not an identity.

Team.description: A club team entered in the league, whoever plays for it.

Roster.description:
Who holds which place on a team: its captain, a reserve board, or its coach.
Coaching a team is not playing for it.

Tutelage.description: Who helps whom prepare: a tutor gives lessons, a second helps analyse before events.

Game.description: One game between two members. white and black are the players; arbiter rules on disputes and is not a player.

questions.q: Who is the captain of the Knight Owls?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Team)-[:captain]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.team_name = 'Knight Owls' RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Team)-[:coach]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.team_name = 'Rook Raiders' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: nilufar
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:coached]->(n1:Team) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.team_name AS team_name

questions.q: Which team does Matteo Gallizia back?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:back]->(n1:Team) WHERE n0.name = 'Matteo Gallizia' RETURN n1.team_name AS team_name

questions.speaker: jiho_b
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:tutor]->(n1:Member) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is the second of Bilal Qureshi?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:second]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.name = 'Bilal Qureshi' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is the pupil of Nilufar Rashidova?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:pupil]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.name = 'Nilufar Rashidova' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Is there a record of the Catalan game being rated?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Game) WHERE n0.opening = 'Catalan' RETURN coalesce(n0.rated, false) AS rated
MATCH (n0:Game) WHERE n0.opening = 'Caro-Kann' RETURN n0.rated AS rated

questions.q: How many moves did the games where Ji-ho Lim had white last?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)<-[:white]-(n1:Game) WHERE n0.name = 'Ji-ho Lim' RETURN n1.move_count AS move_count

questions.q: Who played black in my games as white?
questions.speaker: matteo
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)<-[:white]-(n1:Game)-[:black]->(n2:Member) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n2.name AS name

questions.q: Who was arbiter in the games I played as black?
questions.speaker: bilal
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)<-[:black]-(n1:Game)-[:arbiter]->(n2:Member) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n2.name AS name

questions.q: Which openings were played, and with what result?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Game) RETURN n0.opening AS opening, n0.result AS result

questions.q: What was the result of the game in the Dragon?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Game) WHERE n0.opening CONTAINS 'dragon' RETURN n0.result AS result

questions.q: What is the FIDE ID of Tomasz Wierzbicki?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member) WHERE n0.name = 'Tomasz Wierzbicki' RETURN n0.fide_id AS fide_id
